Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Aurora exec workshop — initial timing questions

Hi Naomi & Grace,

Thanks again for taking this on. Leadership here wants to run a two-day executive workshop the week of Sep 20th that will be split across our Cambridge (MA) HQ and a smaller satellite room in Singapore where a handful of APAC leaders will join remotely in real time. The ask is: can Redwood support a simultaneous hybrid setup so both sites get live facilitation (same agenda, synchronized breaks), and do you have recommended time windows that respect both ET and SGT?

We expect ~18 total attendees at the Cambridge site and 6 at the Singapore location (plus 2-3 remote observers). Key constraints:
- Leaders in Cambridge prefer 9:00–12:30 ET blocks to avoid late afternoons.
- Singapore participants are available 9:00–12:00 SGT (which is 21:00–00:00 ET — not ideal).
- We are open to compressing agenda windows if needed and adding an evening session for APAC the previous day.

Immediate asks:
1) Can you propose two feasible daily time windows that keep at least 2.5 hours of overlap for live Q&A?
2) Confirm whether Redwood can provide on-site AV support in Cambridge (mics, room capture, failover laptop + streaming) and a remote AV technician for Singapore.
3) We may need a visa invitation letter for one visiting exec from India; can you help with a formal template?

Attaching a rough attendee list (see link) — I can share final headcount by Sep 6.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — our procurement will also want any logistics playbook for travel/arrival blocks.

Best,
Alex
Director of Digital Transformation
Aurora Health

Alex — thanks for the clear brief. We can absolutely support a split-site hybrid with parity across both locations. High-level answers up front, followed by requests for a couple items so we can lock logistics: 

Quick proposals for daily synchronized windows (maintain facilitator energy + at least 2.5h overlap):
- Option A (US-friendly): Cambridge 09:00–12:30 ET / Singapore 21:00–00:30 SGT (preferred for Cambridge execs; late for APAC)
- Option B (middle-ground): Cambridge 07:30–11:00 ET / Singapore 19:30–23:00 SGT (earlier for Cambridge; still late for Singapore but gives an extra overlap hour)
- Option C (two-part): Cambridge 09:00–11:30 ET + 15:00–16:30 ET; Singapore joins 21:00–23:30 SGT and APAC-only pre-brief the previous evening — this avoids single-night sessions but splits the day.

Operational capabilities: yes to on-site AV in Cambridge (we provision room capture, redundancies, and local tech for mic mixing + room laptop). We can staff a remote AV lead for Singapore and run a rehearsal 48–72 hours prior.

Visa letter: we have a templated invitation letter (I can provide), plus guidance for turnaround times — usually 3–4 business days once we have the formal name + passport number + travel dates.

To proceed, please provide by Sep 6:
- Final attendee list with full names, roles, passport nationality if travel is needed
- Preferred option among A/B/C above (or confirm you want us to recommend one after we see attendee timezones)
- Any room constraints at Cambridge (ceiling mics or AV racks) — if you can share the floorplan we will annotate suggested camera placements.

Marcus — looping you in to scope vendor engagement, room footprint, and hotel room-block options. Grace — can you coordinate the mutual action plan and share the HubSpot event record if available?

Thanks — attaching our visa-invitation-template and a quick checklist.

Best,
